entry.title: Resolution 29 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County): Adopted → —
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE ACCEPTANCE OF A DONATION OF MATERIALS AND LABOR TO REMODEL A MOBILE OFFICE TRAILER

The donation from University of the Nations, Kona Inc., with an estimated value of $7,000, would be used to upgrade a mobile office trailer being utilized to train lifeguards at Kahalu‘u Beach.

Status: Adopted → —

Latest action: On agenda 2024-12-18
